Upgrade procedure:
1. Download the official 7z<version>-extra.7z asset from ip7z/7zip Releases.
2. Verify the asset against the sha256 digest shown by GitHub for that asset.
3. Extract x64/7za.exe, readme.txt, history.txt and License.txt.
4. Replace the files in this directory and update this file.
5. Run tools/verify-third-party.ps1 and the complete release pipeline.
